mapper.select: select version_code versionCode, display_name displayName, resource_path resourcePath, status, published_at publishedAt from kg_ontology_version where version_code = #{versionCode} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into kg_entity (entity_type, external_key, canonical_name, normalized_name, properties_json, review_status, ontology_version, create_time, update_time) values (#{entityType}, #{externalKey}, #{canonicalName}, #{normalizedName}, #{propertiesJson}, #{reviewStatus}, #{ontologyVersion}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update canonical_name = values(canonical_name), normalized_name = values(normalized_name), properties_json = values(properties_json), review_status = case when review_status = 'ACCEPTED' then 'ACCEPTED' else values(review_status) end, ontology_version = values(ontology_version), update_time = sysdate()

insert into kg_entity_alias (entity_id, alias_name, normalized_alias, source_type, source_ref, create_time) values (#{entityId}, #{aliasName}, #{normalizedAlias}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update alias_name = values(alias_name), source_type = values(source_type), source_ref = values(source_ref)

insert into kg_relation (source_entity_id, relation_type, target_entity_id, confidence, valid_from, valid_to, review_status, ontology_version, source_kind, properties_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{sourceEntityId}, #{relationType}, #{targetEntityId}, #{confidence}, sysdate(), null, #{reviewStatus}, #{ontologyVersion}, #{sourceKind}, #{propertiesJson}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update confidence = values(confidence), valid_to = null, review_status = case when review_status = 'ACCEPTED' then 'ACCEPTED' else values(review_status) end, ontology_version = values(ontology_version), source_kind = values(source_kind), properties_json = values(properties_json), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update kg_relation set valid_to = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where source_entity_id = #{sourceEntityId} and source_kind in ('PROFILE_PROJECTION', 'CERTIFICATION_PROJECTION') and relation_type in ( 'BELONGS_TO', 'HAS_CREDENTIAL', 'EXPERTISE_IN', 'WORKS_IN_INDUSTRY', 'SERVES_REGION', 'HAS_CERTIFICATION' ) and (valid_to is null or valid_to > sysdate())

update kg_relation set valid_to = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where source_entity_id = #{sourceEntityId} and source_kind = 'CERTIFICATION_PROJECTION' and relation_type = 'CERTIFIED_BY' and (valid_to is null or valid_to > sysdate())
mapper.insert: insert into kg_evidence (evidence_key, relation_id, entity_id, source_type, source_ref, material_id, page_no, char_start, char_end, quote_hash, excerpt, confidence, extractor_version, create_time) values (#{evidenceKey}, #{relationId}, #{entityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{materialId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pageNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{charStart,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{charEnd,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{quoteHash}, #{excerpt}, #{confidence}, #{extractorVersion}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update relation_id = values(relation_id), entity_id = values(entity_id), source_type = values(source_type), source_ref = values(source_ref), material_id = values(material_id), page_no = values(page_no), char_start = values(char_start), char_end = values(char_end), quote_hash = values(quote_hash), excerpt = values(excerpt), confidence = values(confidence), extractor_version = values(extractor_version)
mapper.update: update kg_relation r join ( select distinct relation_id from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} ) material_relations on material_relations.relation_id = r.relation_id set r.review_status = #{reviewStatus}, r.valid_to = case when #{reviewStatus} = 'REJECTED' then coalesce(r.valid_to, sysdate()) else null end, r.update_time = sysdate()

update kg_entity e join ( select distinct entity_id from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and entity_id is not null ) material_entities on material_entities.entity_id = e.entity_id set e.review_status = 'ACCEPTED', e.update_time = sysdate()
mapper.delete: delete r from kg_relation r join ( select distinct e.relation_id from kg_evidence e join expert_material m on m.material_id = e.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId} ) material_relations on material_relations.relation_id = r.relation_id
delete e from kg_evidence e join expert_material m on m.material_id = e.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into kg_change_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, event_status, attempt_count, available_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select event_id eventId, event_type eventType, aggregate_type aggregateType, aggregate_id aggregateId, payload_json payloadJson, attempt_count attemptCount, create_time createTime from kg_change_outbox where event_status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= sysdate() order by create_time limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PROCESSING', locked_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_status = 'PENDING'
update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'DONE', last_error = null, update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId}

update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, available_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval least(attempt_count + 1, 60) minute), locked_at = null, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId}

update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PENDING', locked_at = null, available_at = sysdate(), last_error = '处理超时，已重新排队', update_time = sysdate() where event_status = 'PROCESSING' and locked_at < date_sub(sysdate(), interval 10 minute)
mapper.select: select entity_id entityId, entity_type entityType, external_key externalKey, canonical_name canonicalName, normalized_name normalizedName, properties_json propertiesJson, review_status reviewStatus, ontology_version ontologyVersion, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Expert' and external_key = concat('expert:', #{userId})

select entity_id entityId, entity_type entityType, external_key externalKey, canonical_name canonicalName, normalized_name normalizedName, properties_json propertiesJson, review_status reviewStatus, ontology_version ontologyVersion, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from kg_entity where entity_id = #{entityId}
select entity_id from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Task' order by entity_id
mapper.delete: delete from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Expert' and external_key = concat('expert:', #{userId})
mapper.select: select distinct e.entity_id entityId, e.entity_type entityType, e.external_key externalKey, e.canonical_name canonicalName, e.normalized_name normalizedName, e.properties_json propertiesJson, e.review_status reviewStatus, e.ontology_version ontologyVersion, e.create_time createTime, e.update_time updateTime from kg_entity e join kg_evidence ev on ev.entity_id = e.entity_id join expert_material m on m.material_id = ev.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and e.review_status <> 'REJECTED' order by e.entity_id
select dimension_code dimensionCode, capability_code capabilityCode, capability_name capabilityName, ontology_version ontologyVersion from kg_dimension_capability_map order by dimension_code

select a.entity_id assessmentEntityId, a.canonical_name assessmentName, a.properties_json propertiesJson, a.review_status assessmentStatus, r.relation_id relationId, r.review_status relationStatus, r.confidence relationConfidence, ev.evidence_id evidenceId, ev.material_id materialId, ev.excerpt evidence, ev.confidence evidenceConfidence, ev.source_type sourceType, ev.source_ref sourceRef, m.material_category materialCategory, m.version_no versionNo, m.file_name fileName from kg_entity a join kg_relation r on r.target_entity_id = a.entity_id and r.relation_type = 'ASSESSED_AS' join kg_entity expert on expert.entity_id = r.source_entity_id and expert.entity_type = 'Expert' and expert.external_key = concat('expert:', #{userId}) join kg_evidence ev on ev.relation_id = r.relation_id join expert_material m on m.material_id = ev.material_id where a.entity_type = 'CapabilityAssessment' and r.valid_to is null and r.review_status in ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') and m.material_id = ( select max(m2.material_id) from expert_material m2 where m2.user_id = #{userId} and m2.material_category = m.material_category )
and a.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and r.review_status = 'ACCEPTED'
order by m.material_category, a.entity_id, ev.evidence_id
mapper.delete: delete r from kg_relation r join kg_entity a on r.source_entity_id = a.entity_id or r.target_entity_id = a.entity_id where a.entity_type = 'CapabilityAssessment' and a.external_key like concat('assessment:', #{materialId}, ':%');
